create.name: M Yoga de Québec
create.bio:
M Yoga de Québec describes itself as the first Iyengar yoga studio in Quebec City. It opened in 2015 in a multidisciplinary centre on Rue Marie-de-l'Incarnation and is directed by Louis Gérin, a certified Level 2 Iyengar teacher who trained at the Centre de Yoga Iyengar de Montréal with Marie-Andrée Morin, Donna Fornelli and Tim Ruddy after first studying the method in Quebec City. A pianist and music teacher by profession, he also holds a minor in Sanskrit from Université Laval. A small team of certified teachers, including Sylvie Moisan, teaches alongside him, all members of the Iyengar Yoga Association of Canada.

The bright main hall, with a rope wall, chairs, blankets and blocks, hosts classes in French that follow a yearly posture programme for each level, from Level 1 and gentle classes through to intermediate and advanced groups, each ending in Savasana. Classes run in two fifteen-week sessions each autumn and winter, paid for with class cards, and private lessons are available. Occasional three-hour weekend workshops explore a theme in depth for students at Level 2 and above. Since 2021 the studio has run a three-year mentoring programme for experienced students who wish to become certified Iyengar teachers.

courses.title: Cartes de cours (sessions d'automne et d'hiver)
courses.description: Class cards for the studio's fifteen-week autumn and winter sessions, from a single class up to fifteen, with private one-hour lessons priced on the same page. The winter session runs from January to April 2027.
courses.price: 15 cours 280$ + taxes (321,93$); 10 cours 190$ + taxes; 1 cours 22$ + taxes

courses.title: Cours réguliers
courses.description: Graded weekly classes of 75 or 90 minutes that follow an annual posture programme for each level, from Level 1 through intermediate and advanced, and end with Savasana. Newcomers are encouraged to begin at Level 1.

courses.title: Formation des professeurs (mentorat)
courses.description: A mentoring programme of about three years for students with at least three years of Iyengar practice. Apprentices attend two classes a week, assist and teach in Level 1 classes, and meet monthly for three-hour study sessions on the art of teaching.
